title: Crew Revision Create Request
description: POST /api/v1/crews/{crew_id}/revisions. Creates the next immutable revision from the given bindings. A binding that contradicts an existing one yields 409 crew_binding_conflict; the entry role is the single entry_role_id (no per-binding entry flag, so two entries cannot be expressed); a stale base_revision_no yields 409 crew_revision_conflict.

base_revision_no.description: latest_revision_no the client built on (0 = none yet). Stale -> 409 crew_revision_conflict; revision_no is allocated server-side under a row lock on the crew.

entry_role_id.description: The single entry role of the revision (at most one by construction); null until chosen.

unit_ref.description: Reserved (slice 4). MUST be null until slice 4 widens it to a versioned code-identifier reference (GNFR-PRIV-003).

pinned_agent_revision.description: Pinned agent revision; null = follow the agent's latest.

bindings.description: Role bindings; role_id values must belong to this crew and be unique within the request (service check).
